bullets: Lead a team of four building the web version of Osdag. I own its production steel design modules, and the refactor I proposed is now how the team structures new ones.

Set up the production stack: Nginx with SSL, Redis and Celery for the long-running design jobs, and WebSockets for live progress. Before launch I load-tested it at 200+ concurrent requests with 20+ people.
Shipped four modules for IRIS, the ERP that runs NITK: event management, alumni donations, hostel league tracking and service requests.
Built the event workflows with BLoC and Clean Architecture, and added BillDesk payments for alumni donations.
Built Arjun Guruji in 2021 and still maintain it. I rewrote it from native Java to Flutter, and it now has 2,000+ downloads and a 4.9★ rating on Google Play.
Built the event feed for a student-founded events app: paginated, with live filters and notifications for the authors you follow.
Set who can read and write what with Firestore Security Rules, and added media likes and creator filters with Riverpod.
